adaptation: The pinned Vectorized<float>::trunc method maps trunc_impl<float> over lanes; its std::trunc implementation is retained. Float overloads map to equivalent C functions; arrays remain contiguous and dynamic length. The cuDNN graph is mechanically emitted from imported reference IR, with separately tested opcode semantics, not imported cuDNN source.
